#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string str;
    getline(cin, str);
    int n = str.length();
    vector<char> inp(str.begin(), str.end());

    string pos[] = {"00", "25", "50", "75"};
    long long count = 0;

    if (n == 1) {
        if (inp[0] == '0' || inp[0] == 'X' || inp[0] == '_')
            count++;
    } else {
        for (string cstr : pos) {
            int X = -1;
            bool possible = true;
            int idx = 0;
            for (int i = n - 2; i < n; i++) {
                char curr = inp[i];
                char strcurr = cstr[idx];
                idx++;
                if (curr == '_')
                    continue;
                else if (curr == 'X') {
                    if (X == -1)
                        X = strcurr - '0';
                    else if (X != strcurr - '0') {
                        possible = false;
                        break;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (curr != strcurr) {
                        possible = false;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!possible)
                continue;

            if (n == 2) {
                if (cstr[0] == '0')
                    continue;
                count++;
                continue;
            }

            vector<char> ninp = inp;
            int cntX = 0;
            for (char ch : inp)
                if (ch == 'X') cntX++;

            if (X != -1 || cntX == 0) {
                if (X != -1) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
                        if (ninp[k] == 'X')
                            ninp[k] = (char)(X + '0');
                }
                if (ninp[0] == '0')
                    continue;
                long long counter = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n - 2; k++) {
                    if (ninp[k] == '_') {
                        if (k == 0)
                            counter *= 9;
                        else
                            counter *= 10;
                    }
                }
                count += counter;
            } else {
                if (ninp[0] == '0')
                    continue;
                long long counter = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n - 2; k++) {
                    if (ninp[k] == '_') {
                        if (k == 0)
                            counter *= 9;
                        else
                            counter *= 10;
                    }
                }
                if (ninp[0] == 'X')
                    counter *= 9;
                else
                    counter *= 10;
                count += counter;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
